body:
## Pull request overview

Adds a persistent, ObjectQL/IDataEngine-backed implementation of `IAIConversationService` to `@objectstack/service-ai`, and wires the AI plugin to auto-select it when a `data` engine is available (with an explicit override option).

**Changes:**
- Introduces `ObjectQLConversationService` (IDataEngine persistence for conversations/messages, JSON serialization, cascade delete).
- Adds AI system object definitions (`AiConversationObject`, `AiMessageObject`) and registers them via the `app.*` convention for ObjectQL auto-discovery.
- Adds a new vitest suite for the persistent conversation service and updates the changelog.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/plugin.ts | Auto-detects `IDataEngine` (`data`) to choose persistent conversation storage; registers AI system objects via `app.*`. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/objects/index.ts | Central export for AI system object definitions. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/objects/ai-message.object.ts | Defines `ai_messages` system object schema (messages, tool call fields, indexes). |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/objects/ai-conversation.object.ts | Defines `ai_conversations` system object schema (metadata + audit fields, indexes). |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/index.ts | Re-exports new service and object definitions from the package entrypoint. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/conversation/objectql-conversation-service.ts | New persistent `IAIConversationService` implementation backed by `IDataEngine`. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/conversation/index.ts | Exports the new conversation service from the conversation submodule. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/__tests__/objectql-conversation-service.test.ts | Adds tests for CRUD + message/tool serialization using an in-memory `IDataEngine` stub. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the new persistent conversation service and related additions. |
</details>

`crypto.randomUUID()` is used without importing `node:crypto`. In some runtimes `crypto` may be undefined (ReferenceError), which would break conversation/message creation. Prefer importing `randomUUID` from `node:crypto` (or otherwise ensuring a stable UUID source) instead of relying on a global.

Message ordering uses only `created_at`. If multiple messages are inserted within the same timestamp resolution, ordering can become nondeterministic across drivers, affecting replay/chat history. Add a deterministic tie-breaker in `orderBy` (e.g., `created_at` then `id`).
```suggestion
      orderBy: [
        { field: 'created_at', order: 'asc' },
        { field: 'id', order: 'asc' },
      ],
```

`JSON.parse()` on persisted `metadata` and `tool_calls` will throw if the DB contains invalid JSON (e.g., data edited via API/tools). That would make `get()`/`list()` fail for the entire conversation. Consider guarding with try/catch and either returning `undefined`/empty values or throwing a more specific error that identifies the bad row/field.

`updated_at` is not marked `readonly`, but other system objects typically make audit timestamps readonly to prevent API clients from tampering (e.g., `SysUser.updated_at` is `readonly: true`). Consider marking `updated_at` as readonly (and relying on DB defaults/triggers or server-side updates) for consistency and data integrity.
```suggestion
      defaultValue: 'NOW()',
      readonly: true,
```
